Challenge [EDIT]

Icon packs 105 residential units into 65,000 sq ft facing Corferias, Bogotá—a high-visibility urban frontage where residential density, adjacency to the fairgrounds, and livability had to coexist with a strong facade presence and code compliance. [EDIT: confirm lot constraints, height limits, and zoning]

Approach [EDIT]

The design was framed as a mid-to-high-rise residential building facing Corferias: massing and facade that read against the urban edge, compact apartment typologies, and presentation material (project image and clean board) to communicate the design to clients and construction teams.
